plain_text:
Lurene Tuttle appears in 370 recordings across 35 programs in the Golden Radio Hour archive from 1937 to 1979. The credits here include performer, commercial spokesman, and intermission guest.

In this archive, you will hear Lurene Tuttle most often in The Red Skelton Show, The Great Gildersleeve, The Adventures of Sam Spade, Strange Wills, The Whistler, Dr. Christian, Let George Do It, and Lux Radio Theatre.

Characters credited here include Marjorie Forrester and Effie Perrine.
